description: This file defines an interface `UploadedFileFactoryInterface` within the `Psr\Http\Message` namespace, which specifies a method for creating uploaded file instances with various parameters such as stream, size, error code, filename, and media type.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactoryInterface
classes.description: Defines a contract for a factory that creates instances of uploaded files, with a method to construct uploaded file objects from streams and associated metadata.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a new uploaded file instance with provided stream, size, error code, filename, and media type.
